retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the killing of at least half a million Tutsi in Rwanda between April and July 1994. The atlas holds no record of the Rwandan civil war, the Arusha accords, the United Nations mission that was not reinforced, or the wars in Congo that followed, and there is no Portuguese link. Its reach into the rest of this dataset would be through the doctrine of protection that Rwanda and Srebrenica together produced, and that doctrine has no record here either.

title: 1994 Genocide against Tutsi
summary: Wikidata item Q131297, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1994 genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda in which 800,000 were killed". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
